- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The purpose of a peacock's feathers is to attract a mate, signaling genetic fitness and health.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] During courtship, the male peacock fans out his long tail feathers and vibrates them to create a display of color and motion.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The more impressive the display, the more likely the male is to attract a mate.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Feathers also play a role in thermoregulation, controlling heat loss.
